binaryInspection.scope: Manual inspection of actual uninstrumented 16384-tape cursor/control binaries. Emitted C maps f10 to ad.tape and f32 to numeric ad.backward. Allocation equality is established by separate profiles, not inferred solely from assembly. Ordinary saved registers and stack frames remain; no zero-spill claim.

linux-amd.cursorLoadAndBound: f10 0x6eac loads fwp_tape_next_slot; 0x6eba-0x6ebd compares against initialized slots and bypasses the scan at the end.
linux-amd.remainingScan: 0x6ee0-0x6ef8 advances by 104 bytes and tests live/generation fields for arbitrary holes.
linux-amd.advance: 0x7077-0x707b computes slot+1 and stores the cursor.
linux-amd.backwardRelease: f32 0x7912-0x7924 checks generation and lowers the cursor using the decoded token slot; no pointer-difference reconstruction.
linux-amd.control: Restart control f10 0x6ec7 zeros eax before the scan at 0x6ed0-0x6ee8.
linux-amd.storage: Existing geometric realloc branch and one-slot initialization remain; saved registers/stack storage are visible. Cursor reset is stored at 0x72c8.

linux-arm.cursorLoadAndBound: f10 0x60a0 loads the cursor into x22; 0x60a8-0x60ac compares with initialized slots and bypasses scanning at the end.
linux-arm.remainingScan: 0x60cc-0x60ec advances by 104 bytes and retains live/generation checks.
linux-arm.advance: 0x6228 adds one to the selected slot; 0x6234 stores the cursor.
linux-arm.backwardRelease: f32 0x6a54-0x6a78 checks generation and conditionally lowers the cursor using the decoded token slot.
linux-arm.control: Restart control f10 0x60ac initializes x21 from xzr before scanning at 0x60c0-0x60e0.
linux-arm.storage: Existing geometric registry growth remains; the creation frame saves registers in 80 bytes. No heap search index was introduced.

mac-intel.cursorLoadAndBound: f10 0x1000056af loads the cursor; 0x1000056bd-0x1000056c0 compares it with initialized slots and bypasses the scan at the end.
mac-intel.remainingScan: 0x1000056e0-0x1000056f8 advances by 104 bytes and preserves live/generation checks.
mac-intel.advance: 0x10000586c-0x100005870 computes slot+1 and stores the cursor.
mac-intel.backwardRelease: f32 0x100006234-0x10000623b decodes the token; 0x10000630a-0x10000631f checks generation and conditionally decrements/stores the decoded slot, without pointer-difference reconstruction.
mac-intel.control: Restart control f10 0x1000056ca zeros eax before scanning at 0x1000056d0-0x1000056e8.
mac-intel.storage: Existing geometric realloc branch and one-slot initialization remain. Ordinary saved registers, a frame pointer and backward stack storage remain. Shutdown resets the cursor at 0x100005abd.

mac-arm.cursorLoadAndBound: f10 0x100004e40 loads the cursor; 0x100004e4c-0x100004e50 compares with initialized slots and bypasses the scan at the end.
mac-arm.remainingScan: 0x100004e70-0x100004e90 advances by 104 bytes with live/generation checks.
mac-arm.advance: 0x100004fc8-0x100004fcc computes slot+1 and stores the cursor.
mac-arm.backwardRelease: f32 0x1000058b0-0x1000058b4 decodes the token; 0x100005964-0x100005980 checks generation and lowers the cursor with a subtract/store. The preliminary pointer-subtraction, shift and reciprocal-multiply sequence is absent from this release path.
mac-arm.control: Restart control f10 0x100004e4c zeros x21 before scanning at 0x100004e64-0x100004e84.
mac-arm.storage: Existing geometric registry growth and one-slot vector/scalar initialization remain. Creation uses a 96-byte frame and numeric backward a 192-byte frame.

validation.scope: Four native Linux/macOS focused AD and measurement jobs, both focused WASM jobs. Production gates remain separate. Every archived report source/profile/binary/disassembly hash was verified. Manual binary review covers uninstrumented numeric tape creation/backward at 16384 tapes; managed tape release additionally has O1/O2 ARC/tracing positive and omission controls.
